thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-29901 fired — p99 latency threshold breached for /v1/generate in prod-east. SLO burn 42% over 10m. Auto-paginated to #eng-oncall.
oncall_maya: acked — i'm looking now, standing up bridge if needed.
ops_jordan: grabbing shard metrics and nodes. give me 60s.
ops_jordan: grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/prod-east/d/abcd  — p95 jumped 0.37s -> 1.1s, p99 1.6s -> 2.4s in last 12m
eng_sam: seeing KV hitrate drop on inference pods 3-7, lots of cache misses and longer contexts. possibly a client replay.
infra_bot: autoscaler: suppressed scale-out due to cooldown after recent downscale; last downscale at 00:02 UTC. nodepool-g5 reports 2 preemptions in last 8m.
oncall_maya: running cache-warm script: /internal/warm -route /v1/generate -concurrency 8. ping when done.
eng_lead_rosa: if warming not effective in 3m, route 30% traffic to model-fallback-q4 and request Dedicated burst. notify CS if >20m.
eng_sam: applying routing patch to shard prod-east: {"fallback":"gpt-compact-q4","pct":10} — rolling 10% for canary now.
ops_jordan: executed: kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=8  # force scale, pods starting
infra_bot: scale acknowledged, desired=8, ready=2/8 (new pods pulling weights)
oncall_maya: cache warm task completed. initial check: kv_miss_rate down 60% on warmed prefixes.
eng_sam: bumping fallback to 35% and enabling prefix aggregation for long sequences. PATCH -> {"pct":35, "prefix_agg":true}
oncall_maya: applied. watch heatmap — some pods show immediate tail drop.
ops_jordan: spotting a spike of large-seq requests from a single customer CIDR. temporarily applied edge rate limit 15r/s for that CIDR.
cs_anne: noted. I'll draft a soft customer note for impacted accounts and standby for updates.
eng_lead_rosa: good. if p99 drops under 1s within 5m, we'll keep fallback and follow up with post-incident actions. otherwise escalate to oncall-ops for further capacity.
oncall_maya: metrics now: p95=0.48s, p99=0.98s — trending down.
eng_sam: no error rise, only latency. fallback handling looks stable. continuing to monitor. :thumbsup:
infra_bot: new pods ready 8/8. nodepreemptions continue but within tolerance.
ops_jordan: created ticket INF-9921 to relax cooldown and add hotprefix detector that triggers pre-warming earlier.
oncall_maya: holding pager; will hand off to next rotation at 00:50 UTC if stable for 30m.
eng_lead_rosa: capture timeline: cache-warm start, routing 10% -> 35%, rate-limit rule id RL-4412, scale replicas. add to postmortem.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-29901 resolved by oncall_maya — incident closed at 1758888077
oncall_maya: thanks all. I'll publish a short incident summary + action items in #incidents and open Confluence draft.
cs_anne: I'll notify customers on the watchlist with the summary once you drop it.
eng_sam: follow-ups: (1) autoscaler cooldown tuning, (2) prefix cache TTL & aggregation defaults for /v1/generate, (3) hotspot CIDR detection and throttling runbook.
oncall_maya: agreed. closing thread and moving to postmortem write-up.
